rubric: egm estimate succeeds on malformed .oaw/settings.json and silently uses the default token cap instead of refusing the unreadable settings.
trigger: Set a project token cap, truncate .oaw/settings.json to malformed JSON, then run egm estimate docs/plans/small.md docs/context.md --json.
user_impact: The budget command conceals a broken settings file and uses a different budget limit. A user can proceed under the wrong review spending threshold.
intended_lookalikes: Estimates are rough ranges fitted from file sizes, not actual token usage.
An absent settings file legitimately uses the default 25,000,000-token cap.
Setting a cap prints instructions only and does not run a model.
